title: Credit Analyst
description:
Job Brief  



We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Credit Analyst to support our lenders in managing the end-to-end mortgage application process. This role requires a professional with a minimum of 3 to 4 years of specific Australian mortgage and lending experience; as such, we are looking for a candidate who can hit the ground running without the need for foundational training. You will be responsible for the entire lifecycle of a loan, from lead conversion and data entry to credit assessment and post-settlement enquiries. While you will receive initial support, you are expected to take full ownership of your workflow, ensuring all applications meet rigorous credit policies and legislative standards. 



Responsibilities 

Salesforce & LoanApp Management: Managing accurate data entry within Salesforce and overseeing the LoanApp platform to ensure seamless application flows. 

Lead Conversion: Creating leads and converting them into opportunities within the CRM system. 

Application Submission: Submitting completed loan applications to the funder and issuing credit guides where applicable. 

Valuation Management: Ordering and managing valuation reports to ensure property security meets lending criteria. 

Reporting & Title Searches: Generating comprehensive credit reports and completing necessary title searches. 

Progress Draw Management: Overseeing the management of progress draws for construction or staged funding. 

KYC Compliance: Completing Know Your Customer (KYC) verifications using tools such as IDyou or IDkit. 

Documentation & Signatures: Completing all required application forms and coordinating the sending of documents for digital signatures. 

Financial Calculations: Completing funding tables and servicing calculators to determine borrower capacity. 

Credit Proposal Drafting: Drafting detailed credit proposals for formal credit assessment. 

Credit Assessment: Assessing applications prior to submission to the senior credit analyst for final review. 

Policy Compliance: Reviewing credit limits in line with specific internal policies and procedures.

Approval Recommendations: Recommending applications for approval or decline based on risk analysis. 

Underwriter Liaison: Dealing with underwriter Mortgage Information Requests (MIR) and resolving technical queries. 

Outcome Notification: Issuing formal approval or decline letters to relevant parties. 

Settlement Support: Assisting with a wide range of pre-settlement and post-settlement enquiries. 



Requirements 

3–4 years of direct experience in Australian mortgage lending (lender-side experience is essential; broker-side only will not be considered). 

Proven ability to handle the end-to-end loan process with minimal supervision. 

Deep understanding of Australian credit policies and lending benchmarks. 

Advanced analytical, mathematical, and comprehension skills. 

Ability to manage competing deadlines effectively in a high-pressure, fast-paced environment. 

Exceptional attention to detail with the ability to identify discrepancies in complex financial data. 

Strong communication skills for interacting with underwriters and internal stakeholders. 



Software Proficiency 

Salesforce (nice to have) 

LoanApp 

IDyou / IDkit 

Credit Reporting Tools (Equifax / Illion) 

Servicing Calculators 

Microsoft Office Suite 



Education 

Bachelor’s Degree in Finance, Accounting, or other business-related fields. 

Additional certifications in Australian Mortgage Broking or Financial Services are highly desirable. 



Personal Attributes 

Critical thinking – Ability to evaluate applications objectively and identify potential risks. 

Consistent and methodical – A disciplined approach to following processes and procedures. 

Persistence – Dedication to seeing complex applications through to completion and resolving MIRs. 

Team orientated – A collaborative mindset focused on supporting lenders and the wider credit team. 

Love of learning – A desire to stay updated on evolving Australian lending regulations and policies. 



Time Zone: Australian Business Hours 



Applicant Location: Must be located in the Philippines

title: Marketing Coordinator — SEO & Content Production (Remote, Full-Time)
description:
Hours: Full-time, Monday–Friday. Must overlap with Korea Standard Time (KST/GMT+9) business hours.



About Inquivix

Inquivix is a Seoul-based digital marketing agency. We help international companies enter the Korean market through Naver SEO, Kakao advertising, paid media, social media, and web development. Our clients include global hospitality brands, tech companies, and consumer products companies.We are a small, fully remote team. We value people who execute consistently, document their work, and speak up when something is unclear.



The Role

You will produce SEO blog content and marketing deliverables for our client accounts. This is a production role — you will follow a structured process using AI tools (primarily Google Gemini) to research, draft, edit, and deliver publish-ready content at volume.This is not a creative writing role. You are a content production operator. You follow a defined process, hit quality standards, and deliver on time.



What you will do every day:

- Produce 2–5 blog posts per day using our structured AI-assisted content production process

- Research topics, build outlines, generate drafts using Gemini, and edit to publish-ready quality

- Follow SEO best practices — keyword placement, heading structure, internal linking, meta descriptions

- Self-review every piece before submission using our quality checklist

- Submit work with honest self-assessment of quality (we train you to improve — but we need you to be honest about where you are)

- Update task status and deadlines in our project management tool (NiftyPM)

- Flag blockers, missing briefs, or unclear instructions to your PM immediately — do not guess



Requirements:

- Strong written English. You will produce English-language content daily. Grammar, structure, and clarity matter.

- Experience with SEO content writing — you understand what keywords, search intent, heading structure, and on-page SEO mean. You do not need to be an expert, but you need to know the basics.

- Comfortable using AI tools for content production. If you already use ChatGPT, Gemini, or Claude for writing, say so. If you have not used them, you must be willing to learn quickly — this is not optional.

- Reliable and consistent. You will be expected to hit daily output targets. If you cannot produce work consistently without someone reminding you, this role is not a fit.

- Able to self-assess your own work honestly. We will ask you to rate your own output and identify weak spots. This is how we help you improve. If you think everything you produce is perfect, we cannot help you grow.



Strong advantage (not required):

- Experience writing content for the Korean market or Korean platforms (Naver Blog, Tistory)

- Basic Korean language ability

- Experience with content production workflows at an agency or media company

- Familiarity with WordPress, Naver Blog, or other CMS platforms



This role is NOT a good fit if you:

- See yourself as a "creative writer" who does not want to follow a structured process

- Need constant supervision to stay productive

- Are not comfortable with AI tools or believe they are "cheating"

- Cannot handle producing multiple pieces of content per day



How to apply:

Send your resume and answer these three questions:

1. Do you have experience writing SEO-optimized content? If yes, give one example — what was the topic, what keyword were you targeting, and where was it published?

2. Have you used AI tools (ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, Jasper, etc.) for content production? If yes, how did you use them — what was your process?

3. What is your expected monthly salary in PHP?



Applications that do not answer these three questions will not be reviewed.

s daily. Professional, structured, no filler.

- Reliable internet and quiet workspace for video calls.



Strong advantage (not required):

- Familiarity with AI tools (Gemini, ChatGPT, Claude) for work tasks

- Need to be told what to do each day

- Have only managed internal operations or BPO workflows (no agency client account experience)

- Are uncomfortable giving direct status updates and flagging problems early

Experience with:

The ideal candidate brings hands-on experience in legal billing, particularly in family law, and is comfortable managing trust accounts, communicating with clients about balances, and partnering with attorneys to ensure accurate, timely billing.



Key Responsibilities



Trust & Retainer Management

Monitor client trust balances daily and flag accounts that fall below the minimum retainer threshold

Send timely replenishment requests to clients and follow up to ensure funds are received before work continues

Apply trust funds correctly in Clio and ensure IOLTA compliance at all times

Maintain accurate records of all trust transactions and payment activity



Billing & Invoicing

Review and audit attorney and paralegal time entries for accuracy, clarity, and completeness before billing

Generate pre-bills, final invoices, and monthly review letters in Clio

Ensure all billing descriptions clearly communicate the value of work performed to the client

Manage work-in-progress (WIP) and coordinate with attorneys on billing cycles

Run billing reports and provide regular summaries to the Controller and Office Manager



Collections & AR Management

Follow up on past-due balances in a professional and non-confrontational manner

Set up and monitor client payment plans; escalate accounts that are not progressing

Partner with attorneys on client calls when billing-related issues require legal explanation

Initiate disengagement processes when appropriate and directed

Maintain accurate accounts receivable records and prepare write-off requests for management approval



Client Communication

Handle a minimum of 10 client calls daily (collections + billing inquiries + new client billing setup)

Communicate clearly regarding balances, statements, and payment options

Respond promptly and professionally, de-escalating concerns when needed

Ensure alignment with the legal team on all billing communications



System & Process Support

Maintain and update client billing records in Clio

Assist in identifying and implementing process improvements to billing workflows

Support onboarding of new clients by setting up billing profiles and retainer agreements in the system



Qualifications



Required

Minimum 2 years of legal billing experience, preferably in family law or a similarly complex practice area

Strong understanding of IOLTA trust accounting rules and compliance requirements

Experience with Clio or comparable legal practice management software

Proficiency in managing WIP, invoicing, trust fund applications, and billing reports

Excellent attention to detail with a strong track record of accuracy in billing and financial records

Professional written and verbal communication skills, especially in client-facing situations

Ability to handle sensitive billing conversations with discretion and composure

Highly organized with the ability to manage multiple matters and deadlines simultaneously

Preferred

Bilingual in English and Spanish — strongly preferred to support our diverse client base

Experience with collections and payment plan management in a legal setting

Familiarity with Maryland family law billing practices, retainer structures, and court fee schedules

Comfort working in a remote environment and collaborating with attorneys and staff across time zones



What We Offer

A collaborative, remote-first team environment

Meaningful work supporting clients through one of the most important transitions in their lives

Competitive compensation commensurate with experience

Opportunity to grow within a firm that values systems, accountability, and continuous improvement



How to Apply

Please submit your resume and a brief cover letter outlining your legal billing experience, familiarity with trust accounting, and any experience with Clio or similar platforms. Bilingual candidates are encouraged to note their language proficiency.



As part of the application process, please also complete the initial interview using the link below:



Initial Interview Link: 



Applications that include both a resume and completed initial interview will be prioritized.

title: Amazon Graphic Design Lead
description:
Job Summary

Buttercrafts is a growing e-commerce brand selling printable vinyl, UV laminates, and sticker-making supplies on Amazon USA (expanding to the UK in 2026). We're looking for a full-time Graphic Designer to own our Amazon listing visuals — main images, secondary infographics, A+ content, and product packaging and inserts. We'll give you the product context and the goal. You bring the design direction. No hand-holding. We run a lean, remote team and need someone who thinks, not just executes.



Key Responsibilities:

- Design and optimize Amazon listing images — main image, secondary infographics, and lifestyle shots

- Create A+ content modules and brand story visuals for Amazon listings

- Design product packaging and customer insert cards

- Maintain visual consistency across listings as new products are added

- Ensure all designs clearly communicate product benefits and align with brand guidelines



Requirements:

- Minimum 3 years experience as a graphic designer

- Strong portfolio showing Amazon listing work — main images, A+ content, infographics. Applications without relevant portfolio samples will not be considered.

- Proficient in Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator) — please state which tools you use day-to-day

- Able to work independently with minimal direction. We do not micromanage and will not spoon-feed briefs.

- Direct experience designing for Amazon's platform is required

- If you use AI design tools (e.g. Figma Weave, Midjourney, Adobe Firefly), please mention this in your application and show examples. This will be a BIG plus — but do not claim it if you don't use it.

- Experience in an agency setting is a plus



Employment Details:

- Hours: Full-time (40 hours per week)

- 10am to 6pm (Mon to Fri)

- Compensation: $600 per month, with potential for increase based on performance

- Location: Remote 



Application Process

To apply, please send the following:

- Your resume

- Portfolio or portfolio link — must include Amazon listing work (main images, A+ content, or infographics). Applications without this will not be considered.

- A short note on the design tools you use, including any AI tools

- A short video (2–3 minutes) introducing yourself and explaining why you're a good fit for this role. This is optional but applicants who include a video will be reviewed first.



We regret that only shortlisted candidates will be contacted due to the volume of applicants.

title: Instagram Content Creator & Social Media Manager
description:
**Job Title:** Instagram Content Creator & Social Media Manager



**About Us**

Dolce Society is an Italian-inspired clothing brand built around effortless elegance, war
diterranean aesthetics, and timeless style. We are growing our Instagram presence and need a creative, detail-oriented person to help bring the brand to life every day.



**What you'll do**

- Create and publish at least one feed post per day

- Create daily Stories

- Create Reels regularly

- All content is created digitally using AI tools and online sources — no filming or photography required



**What I'm looking for**



The most important skill for this role is AI image generation. You need to be genuinely proficient — not just writing a prompt and taking the first output, but iterating, combining multiple references, and refining until the result looks real, polished, and indistinguishable from professional photography. I will provide guidelines and some references, but you also need to be able to source your own references and bring creative ideas to the table.



You should also be:

- Comfortable using CapCut for Reels editing (trimming, text overlays, transitions, music)

- Able to write engaging captions in English with a subtle Italian cultural sensibility — copy will be AI-assisted but needs a genuine voice

- A strong eye for detail, quality, and what feels authentic vs. artificial

- Reliable and consistent — this is a daily output role



To apply, please include:

1. Examples of AI-generated images you have created — ideally showing your process or multiple iterations, not just final outputs

2. Examples of Reels you have edited

3. Examples of Stories you have created

4. A brief note on which AI image generation tools you use and how you work with them



**Before moving forward**, shortlisted candidates will be asked to complete a short test task — no more than 1–2 hours — involving creating an AI-generated image and a short Reel for Dolce Society. Full instructions and references will be provided. Please confirm in your application that you are willing to complete this test task if selected.

title: Experienced Appointment Setter - B2C
description:
Appointment Setter — Full Time, Remote US Hours



We’re hiring two Remote Appointment Setters for a US-based marketing agency in the residential house cleaning industry.



Your role is simple: respond to inbound homeowner leads, qualify them, answer basic questions, provide quotes using our system, and book cleaning appointments directly onto the calendar for our cleaning company partners.



You’ll be speaking with homeowners across the US who are actively looking for house cleaning services. Speed, communication, organization, and confidence on the phone matter a lot in this role.



You’ll work closely with our internal team and become a key part of helping local cleaning businesses grow.



WHAT YOU’LL DO



* Call and text inbound homeowner leads quickly after they come in

* Qualify homeowners and gather cleaning details

* Use our pricing system to provide quotes

* Book appointments directly onto the calendar

* Follow up with unresponsive leads

* Handle basic objections and questions confidently

* Update lead notes and statuses inside our CRM

* Communicate with the internal team through Slack



WHO YOU ARE



* Comfortable speaking on the phone for multiple hours per day

* Strong spoken and written English

* Friendly, confident, and conversational

* Organized and able to manage follow-ups

* Fast responder and dependable

* Calm under pressure

* Coachable and willing to improve

* Able to work independently remotely



BONUS POINTS



* Appointment setting experience

* Customer service experience

* Call center experience

* Experience using GoHighLevel or CRMs

* Home services or cleaning industry experience



TOOLS



GoHighLevel, Slack, Google Workspace, and calling/texting software.



Experience with any is a plus, but we can train the right person.



DETAILS



* full-time immediate start

* Opportunity for additional hours based on performance

* Must be available during US Eastern Time hours

* Performance bonuses available based on booked appointments and consistency



HOW TO APPLY



1. Vocaroo Voice Recording (Required)



Record a 2–3 minute introduction at 
 answering:



* Your background and work experience

* Any phone, customer service, or appointment setting experience

* Why you’d be a strong fit for this role

2. Resume or Summary of Experience



Applications without the Vocaroo recording will not be considered.



Looking forward to hearing from you.

Required Skills & Experience



    Proven Track Record: A portfolio of successfully published Wikipedia entries for companies, public figures, or media outlets.

title: Lighting Designer
description:
A lighting designer is a professional who specializes in creating and managing lighting schemes for various environments and purposes. This role is crucial in fields such as theater, film, television, architecture, and interior design. Here's a detailed description of a lighting designer's responsibilities and skills:



1. **Design and Conceptualization**: Develop innovative lighting designs that enhance the aesthetic appeal and functionality of a space or production. This includes understanding the project's needs, conceptualizing lighting effects, and creating mood and atmosphere.

2. **Technical Knowledge**: Possess a strong understanding of lighting equipment and technology, including types of lights, control systems, and software used for lighting design.

3. **Collaboration**: Work closely with other professionals such as directors, architects, interior designers, and event planners to ensure that the lighting aligns with the overall vision of the project.

4. **Planning and Implementation**: Create detailed plans and drawings, specifying the placement and type of lighting fixtures. Oversee the installation and operation of the lighting setup.

5. **Budget Management**: Estimate costs for lighting design projects, ensuring that designs stay within budget constraints.

6. **Problem-Solving Skills**: Address challenges that arise during design and implementation, such as spatial limitations or specific technical requirements.

7. **Adaptability**: Adjust designs for different types of spaces and purposes, whether it’s for dramatic effect in a theater production, functional lighting in a building, or ambiance creation in an event.

8. **Safety and Regulations Compliance**: Ensure that lighting designs comply with all relevant safety standards and regulations.

9. **Continued Learning**: Stay updated with the latest trends, technologies, and best practices in lighting design.



A lighting designer needs a blend of creative vision and technical expertise, along with strong communication and project management skills. Formal education in lighting design or a related field is often beneficial, as is experience in relevant industries.

title: Graphic Designer — Brochure Layout Reconstruction
description:
About ScaffCover

ScaffCover is an Australian company making premium engineered scaffold containment and protection systems for the construction industry. Our brand sits at the high end of the market — clean, architectural, technical — and our marketing materials need to reflect that.



The Role (Please Read Carefully)

We use AI tools to generate brochure layouts we like — the typography, spacing, composition, and styling. The problem is that AI mangles our real product photos and designs when we try to drop them in.

Your job is to rebuild those AI-generated layouts inside a professional design program, pixel-faithful to the AI version, but with our real images, logos, and copy swapped in cleanly.

This is a reconstruction and asset-replacement role. It is not a redesign role.

We want someone who can look at an AI layout and say "I can match that exactly in my design software so it's editable and print-ready" — not someone who wants to reinterpret it, improve it, or put their own spin on it. We hired someone last round who took creative liberties and the result was unusable. Please only apply if you are genuinely happy executing to a brief without changing it.



What You'll Receive From Us



The AI-generated layout (as reference for fonts, spacing, composition)

Our real photography and product imagery

Logo files, brand guide, colour palette, approved typography

All copy, headings, technical specs, captions



What You'll Deliver



An editable source file in your chosen design program, matching the AI layout

Real ScaffCover assets correctly placed where AI placeholders were

Print-ready PDFs

Organised file structure with linked assets





First Project

A premium 20-page company brochure — mix of single pages, double-page spreads, technical/product pages, and editorial-style layouts.



Required Skills



Strong skills in a professional design program — Adobe InDesign, Illustrator, Affinity Publisher/Designer, or similar layout software (whichever you use, the file needs to be fully editable and print-ready)

Editorial / brochure layout experience

Typography hierarchy and spacing

Print preparation and file organisation

Ability to match a reference layout precisely



Bonus (not required)



Construction, industrial, architectural, or engineering brand work

Experience working from AI-generated mockups





Test Task (Unpaid)

Shortlisted applicants will be sent a focused test task. We'll provide:



The AI-generated layout (one page — the middle page of the brochure)

The hero image to be placed on that page

Our brand board

The exact text/copy as shown in the AI layout



Your task is to recreate that page exactly as the AI has laid it out — same fonts, same spacing, same composition, same hierarchy — using the real image and copy we provide, inside your chosen design program. Return the editable source file plus a PDF.

We are specifically evaluating:



Layout accuracy vs the AI reference

Typography fidelity (font choices, sizing, spacing)

Correct use of our brand assets

Ability to follow direction exactly without reinterpreting

File organisation and professionalism



The task is unpaid. We receive a high volume of applications and the test is how we determine fit. Please only apply if you're comfortable with that.



Long-Term Opportunity

If the first brochure goes well, ongoing work includes product sheets, technical documents, advertisements, signage, exhibition graphics, presentation decks, and social media assets.



How To Apply

Applications missing any of the following will not be reviewed:



One paragraph describing a time you rebuilt or matched someone else's layout exactly — not designed your own. If you don't have this experience, please be honest.

The design program you'll use for this work, and how long you've used it

Your weekly availability and timezone

Your expected rate (per hour or per month in PHP or USD)

Your WhatsApp number — we'll contact shortlisted applicants via WhatsApp to send through the test task



To prove you've read this post in full, please start your application with the word: "SCAFFOLD"

title: Short-form video editing + Content scripting + DM setting
description:
So there's 3 tasks I am currently doing right now on a daily/weekly basis that I need to delegate to a VA. I run a marketing agency and have clients in the mentoring niche (they teach people how to day trade, sports bet, dropshipping)



I will need 5 short-form videos scripted out per client per week, done in one go at the end of the week, ready for clients to record at the start of the following week.



Then when my clients record the videos, they'll upload the raw footage to a google drive. I want the raw videos edited preferably in Davinci Resolve (i timed myself and it took roughly 30 mins per video to be edited), all in one go at the start of the week (Monday) or end of the week (Saturday/Sunday) so i can schedule to post them out every day/once every two days.



As for dm setting, my leads come in to the CRM (GHL) and one of the questions in the lead form is asking for their 
 
 So when they give their 
 and it is a real username, i send a friend request. When I send a friend request, they add me as friend and hence I am able to message them. If they are not a friend on 
, it won't let me message them due to their privacy settings unless we have a mutual server together. When they accept my friend request, I just dm them and then set them onto a discovery/closing call. The pay for DM setting will not be $x/hr, it will be base on tiers/stages.



Because for short form content scripting and video editing, its self-explanatory that you put down X hour in your day to make it all in one go. (I have all the SOPs on how to do that). But for dm setting, a lead can come in 9am and another at 5pm, that wouldn't count as 8 hours of work since you didn't do anything for the whole 8 hours, you'd probably spend at most 10 mins each lead (from first message to booked), whilst sometimes you could send the lead a friend request and they never accept it. or sometimes during the convo, they drop off and don't reply, or even reply a few hours later. Hence why i think the best way is we just do a fixed amount for different stages of a lead. so a price for if the lead gets qualified and booked, if lead got added on 
 only, if lead was messaged but dropped off. 



Pay will be weekly.

title: Senior Full Stack AI Video Editor – DTC Supplements
description:
Senior Full Stack AI Video Editor – Aviora

Aviora is a fast-scaling DTC supplement brand built around high-conviction products and even higher-conviction marketing. Our video creative is the engine of our growth — and we're building the team that keeps that engine running at scale.

We're looking for a full stack AI video editor who doesn't just use AI tools — they master them. Someone who knows the difference between a hook that gets scrolled past and one that stops a feed cold. If you've been quietly building a skillset in AI-native video production and you're ready to put it to work on a brand with real 
ntum, this is your opportunity.



YOUR MISSION

Own the end-to-end production of high-converting AI video ads for Aviora's paid social channels. You will work from proven scripts and frameworks, using the full range of AI video and audio tools to produce polished, on-brand, compliant content at consistent volume — without sacrificing the quality that drives performance.



RESPONSIBILITIES



Produce approximately 10 completed AI video ads per day following preset scripts, styles, and brand guidelines

Execute full production workflows: AI avatar generation, voiceover synthesis, B-roll sourcing and generation, caption styling, and final assembly

Use tools across the AI video ecosystem (HeyGen, Veo 3, Higgsfield, Gemini, Captions AI, ElevenLabs, and others) to generate and assemble content efficiently

Apply direct-response principles when reviewing and refining scripts prior to production

Analyze video performance metrics to identify patterns in what's working and apply those learnings to future output

Stay ahead of the curve — new tools, new formats, and new platform trends need to be absorbed and applied quickly, sometimes overnight

Maintain a 90%+ first-pass approval rate; precision and attention to brief are more valuable than flashy technique

As a foundational hire, you'll help shape and document the internal production playbook and train future editors to our standards





OUR TECH STACK



Video Editing: CapCut Pro, Adobe Premiere Pro

AI Video Generation: Veo 3, HeyGen, Higgsfield, Kling, Runway ML

AI Assistants & Multimodal: Gemini, ChatGPT, Claude

AI Image Tools: Midjourney, Flux Kontext Pro, Krea

AI Audio: ElevenLabs

Communication & Project Management: Slack, 





KPIs YOU WILL OWN



10 Daily Video Quota: 10 completed videos per day, delivered weekdays by 7PM ET

90% First-Pass Approval Rate: Submissions must match the brief precisely with minimal revision cycles

Performance Bonuses: Tied directly to view counts and conversion benchmarks hit by your videos





WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR



Proven track record producing short-form direct-response video ads for DTC or eCommerce brands

Deep, hands-on experience with AI video generation tools — HeyGen, Veo 3, Higgsfield, Gemini video workflows, and similar platforms

Proficiency in CapCut Pro or Adobe Premiere Pro

Solid understanding of direct-response copywriting as it applies to short-form video

Ability to maintain brand consistency and compliance across high volumes of content

Self-starter mentality — you own your queue, hit your deadlines, and escalate proactively when needed

Genuine enthusiasm for AI tools and the rapidly shifting landscape of social video





WHY JOIN AVIORA



Performance Bonuses: When your videos convert, you earn. Simple as that

Cutting-Edge Stack: You'll work with the most advanced AI video tools available — and be the first to test new ones

High Impact: Your videos will reach millions of people and directly drive revenue for a brand that's growing fast

Foundational Role: You're not joining a bureaucracy — you're joining early and helping define how things are done

Fully Remote: Work from anywhere in the world

Results-Driven Flexibility: We measure output, not hours. Meet the daily deadline, show up for the Monday team call at 12PM ET, and stay reachable during core hours (9AM–8PM ET)





THIS ROLE IS NOT FOR YOU IF

You're a perfectionist who loses hours to fine-tuning details that don't move the needle. The daily quota is real — efficiency and adherence to the brief matter more than personal artistic refinement.

You prefer collaborative, meeting-heavy environments. This is a heads-down, autonomous production role. Most of your day is independent execution, not group brainstorming.

You find it stressful when tools or workflows change without warning. In AI video, the landscape shifts constantly — sometimes the tool you built your workflow around gets replaced overnight. You need to pivot without friction.

You want to specialize in one tool or technique and go deep. This role requires fluency across the full AI production stack. Adaptability and breadth are more valuable than depth in any single platform.



HOW TO APPLY

We want to hear from elite AI video editors who are genuinely excited by the pace and scale of what we're building at Aviora. Answer all application questions in full, demonstrate how your past experience maps directly to this role, and show us what you can do.

Include the code word 'DetailsMatter' somewhere in your application. Applications without it will not be reviewed. We mean it — it's the first test.

This is a fully remote opportunity.

title: Bookkeeper & Administrator
description:
Position Description – Bookkeeper (Full Time, Remote – Philippines)

Employer: DCON Painting & Sons Pty Ltd

Reports to: Director 



We are a family owned and operated Commercial Painting Company with over 90 years combined experience, we have grown significantly in the past few years to successfully service all Commercial Painting contracts across all of Regional Victoria including Ballarat, Geelong & Melbourne. We take pride in accuracy, efficiency, and attention to detail across both our finance and operational functions.

We are seeking a detail-oriented and reliable Bookkeeper & Administrator to support our finance function and business compliance requirements. The role is partly focused on accounts payable, purchase orders, bank reconciliations, and maintaining accurate financial records. The other focus will be assisting with the compliance such as attending to SWIM safe methods, inbox management, and attend to other Occupational Health & Safety compliance requirements. The successful candidate will work with cloud-based systems including Xero, Simpro and Microsoft products.



Key Responsibilities

•Accounts Payable:

o Manage invoices that arrive via
 into Simpro or Xero, ensuring they are coded correctly.

o Confirm every invoice is linked to a Purchase Order (PO) before being synced into Xero. Ensure costs are correctly allocated to the right projects/jobs.

o Identify mismatches between invoices and POs and escalate for review.

o Process supplier invoices accurately and in a timely manner.

o Reconcile supplier statements and maintain accurate AP ledgers.

•General Bookkeeping:

o Perform bi-weekly reconciliations in Xero.

o Ensure all transactions are accurately allocated with supporting documentation.

o Attend to payroll for 5-8 staff. 

o Assist with general ledger reconciliations.

o Provide financial admin support to the finance team as required.

o Inter-company loan reconciliations.

o End-of-month close checklist & preparation of monthly reports.

•General Administration, Compliance & OH&S Support:

o Set up SWMS / SWIMs and job compliance documentation in Simpro for each new project, ensuring all required documents are completed and issued prior to site commencement. 

o Assist with job start up administration in Simpro, including linking relevant compliance documents to jobs and supporting the operational start up process.

o Prepare, complete, and maintain supplier and subcontractor warranty documentation, including: 

? Completing warranty templates where required

? Collecting warranty information from suppliers and subcontract painters

? Ensuring warranties meet head contractor and builder requirements

? Uploading and filing warranties correctly in Simpro and internal systems

o Compile and maintain builder / head contractor welcome packs for operational teams using information stored in Simpro, including: 

? Builder and site contact details

? Site address and project information

? Relevant induction, onboarding, and administrative documentation

o Maintain accurate and up to date builder, head contractor, and subcontractor records in Simpro, including contact details, compliance documents, and job specific requirements.

o Support a highly subcontractor reliant commercial painting environment, ensuring documentation flows correctly between painters, suppliers, head contractors, and internal teams.

? Provide general administrative support including inbox management, scheduling assistance, and compliance tracking as required.



Ideal Qualifications & Attributes

• 2+ years in bookkeeping, financial administration, or accounts payable.

• Experience with Xero and cloud-based finance systems.

• Familiarity with Simpro + PO workflows in construction.

• Strong knowledge of GST in Australia and how it applies to invoices and expenses.

• Exceptionally high attention to detail and accuracy.

• Organised and structured work habits.

• Strong communication skills and English proficiency (written).

• Previous experience with Australian businesses (construction industry preferred).

Practical Requirements

• 5-day availability during Australian business hours (AEST/AEDT).

• Quiet, dedicated workspace.

• Reliable high-speed internet connection with back-up access.

• Commitment to a long-term role.

We Offer

• Training and support from an experienced finance team.

• Long-term growth opportunities within a stable, established company.

• A supportive and professional remote work environment where your contribution is valued.



Application Process

Please submit:

• Your updated resume and LinkedIn profile link.

• Names and contact details of three references (2 professional + 1 personal).

Test Questions (for application)

1. Purchase Orders

o Why is it important to ensure that every invoice is matched to a PO in the construction industry?

o If an invoice comes into SmoothX (ProScan which is a part of Simpro software) without a matching PO, what steps would you take?

2. GST

o An invoice shows a total of $5,500 including GST. How much is the GST component, and what is the net amount before GST?

o A subcontractor’s invoice comes through SmoothX but states “Not registered for GST.” How would you code this in Xero?

3. Practical AP Scenario

o You receive an invoice for concrete supplies
ed into SmoothX. The PO in Procore shows 100 units at $10 each, but the invoice shows 120 units at $10 each. What would you do before processing this invoice?

4. Bank Reconciliation

o During reconciliation, you notice a $200 payment in the bank feed that does not yet match to a bill in Xero. What process would you follow?



Thanks in advance for your consideration and application.

title: Fitness Coach Recipe Data Entry and Rebranding
description:
6-8 HRS PER MONTH JOB



This job is broken up into 3 main categories: 



Rebranding colours- This job requires you to change a monthly recipe Ebook, every month, so that it reflects our Online Coaching brand name. This includes changing the titles, colour schemes of an original recipe ebook (that i will send you) deleting images, rebranding so that it has our image.



Data entry- This job entails you to use MyFitnessPal on your computer AND phone to make food entries for each of the recipes in the Ebook and enter them in as recipes from our company name 'Lift With Zac'. The data you enter includes recipe name, company name, calorie amount, protein, carbs, fats and fibre. 



Barcode generation- After each recipe has been entered into MyFitnessPal with OUR company name attached, you will need to generate barcodes for each recipe. This component requires methodical thinking and high organisational skills. The barcode you generate and download will be placed onto each recipe template so that our clients can scan the barcode and easily track their macros on MyFitnessPal. This step will involve asking chatgpt to give you EAN-13 codes to generate into barcodes. These barcodes will then need to be linked with a recipe from the data entry you completed above.



You will need to keep track of the codes you link the recipes to, and you will do this via google sheets. You will also need to download each barcode and keep in an organised folder on your computer so that you can easily drag over the barcode to match the correct recipe.  



Platforms you MUST be familiar with include: 

MyFitnessPal

Google Sheets

Chatgpt

Barcode generator

title: AI SMS & Automation Specialist (GoHighLevel + CloseBot)
description:
AI SMS & Automation Specialist (GoHighLevel + CloseBot)



TYPE OF WORK: Part Time

WAGE / SALARY: $8–12 AUD/hr (based on experience)

HOURS PER WEEK: 15–20





READ THIS BEFORE YOU APPLY



This role is not for people who have installed GoHighLevel snapshots and called it automation experience. We are not looking for someone who can follow a YouTube tutorial.



We need someone who has actually built AI SMS systems, chatbots, and automation workflows from scratch inside GoHighLevel — systems that qualify leads, book appointments, reactivate dead databases, and generate reviews. If you have not done this with real clients and real results, this is not the right role.



If you have built these systems and can prove it — keep reading.





ABOUT US



Genghis Digital is a web design and digital marketing agency based in Perth, Australia. We build websites and run marketing campaigns for service-based businesses across trades, health, real estate, professional services, and events.



We are growing our remote team and looking for a GHL automation specialist who can own the setup, management, and optimisation of AI-powered SMS and chat systems across our client accounts. You will work directly with the founder — no layers of management, no approval chains for every decision.





WHAT YOU WILL BE BUILDING



- AI SMS chatbots inside GoHighLevel and CloseBot that qualify leads and book appointments automatically

- Database reactivation campaigns that re-engage cold and inactive leads with personalised AI-driven SMS sequences

- Speed-to-lead automations that respond to Meta ad leads and website enquiries within seconds

- Website chatbots for lead capture, qualification, and routing

- Review generation and reputation management workflows that trigger after service delivery

- After-hours call handling systems with automated SMS follow-ups

- Pipeline and workflow logic including triggers, tagging, conditional branching, and AI prompt engineering inside GHL





WHAT WE NEED FROM YOU (NON-NEGOTIABLE)



- Hands-on experience building AI SMS or chat bots inside GoHighLevel that have booked real appointments for real clients — not demo accounts or test builds

- Understanding of speed-to-lead logic and why responding in under 60 seconds matters

- Ability to build and troubleshoot workflows, pipelines, triggers, tags, and conditional logic without being walked through it

- Experience with CloseBot or similar AI SMS tools integrated with GHL

- A proactive mindset — when a campaign underperforms or a bot stops converting, you identify the issue and fix it before being asked

- Comfortable working with AI prompts — you understand how to write and refine prompts that generate natural, conversion-focused SMS replies





NICE TO HAVE



- Experience running database reactivation campaigns with measurable results (reply rates, booking rates, reactivated revenue)

- Familiarity with review generation workflows and reputation management automation

- Experience with webhook integrations, Zapier, or Make connecting GHL to external tools

- Understanding of local service businesses (trades, dental, physio, real estate, legal) and what their leads expect

- Experience building or optimising missed call text-back systems





WHY WORK WITH US



- Work directly with the founder — no middle management, no bureaucracy

- Clear ownership of systems — you build it, you run it, you optimise it

- Variety of industries and client types so the work does not get repetitive

- Long-term role with a growing agency — this is not a one-off project or a 3-month contract

- Performance-focused environment — we care about results, not hours logged

- Weekly pay via Wise

- Part-time hours (15–20 per week) with potential to grow as client base expands





WORK SETUP



- Remote role (Philippines preferred)

- Must be responsive during AWST business hours (9:00 AM – 5:00 PM AWST, Perth time)

- Reliable internet connection and power backup required

- Weekly pay via Wise





HOW TO APPLY



To confirm you have read this entire ad, include the word TRIGGER in the first line of your application.



Then send:



1. A short explanation (text or Loom video) of AI SMS or automation systems you have built inside GoHighLevel — what the system did, who it was for, and what results it produced

2. One or two specific examples of chatbot workflows, database reactivation campaigns, or speed-to-lead systems you have implemented — screenshots, Loom walkthroughs, or written case studies

3. Your expected hourly rate within the $8–12 AUD range

4. Your timezone and weekly availability



Applications without the filter word will not be reviewed.

Applications without hands-on GHL implementation examples will not be considered.

Do not send a generic VA resume. Show us what you have built.





FINAL FILTER



This role is for builders — not button-pushers.



If you can open GoHighLevel right now, build a workflow from scratch that qualifies a lead by SMS and books them into a calendar without human intervention, and then explain why you structured it the way you did — you are exactly who we are looking for.



If you need someone to hand you a snapshot and tell you what to change — this is not the right fit.

- Sell residential cleaning services to American homeowners

- Handle objections like “I need to think about it”

- Assign cleaners to jobs

- Handle reschedules and callouts

- Communicate with clients when something goes wrong

- Coordinate with cleaners through Slack and text

- Confirm schedules and job details

- Help resolve no-shows, late arrivals, and quality issues

- Complete Sunday lead data entry and reconciliation

We are looking for someone who takes ownership.



If something is broken, you fix it.  

If a lead goes quiet, you follow up again.  

If a cleaner does not show up, you do not wait around. You start solving the problem.



You should have:



- Prior cleaning business experience

- Strong spoken and written English

- Sales ability and confidence on the phone

- Calm judgment under pressure

- Strong attention to detail

- Reliable internet and work setup

- High ownership and follow-through

title: Adobe InDesign Textbook Layout Assistant
description:
We are looking for a detail-oriented Adobe InDesign assistant to help create a series of professionally published instructional textbooks for public speaking and debate students.



This is a long-term remote project, likely lasting 9–12 months, with the possibility of continued work afterward. The books are for students from early elementary through high school, and the first major project is a colorful, kid-friendly textbook for Grades 3–5 featuring cartoon “SuperTeam” characters.



The ideal candidate is not just a general graphic designer, but someone who is comfortable working carefully inside InDesign: applying styles, following layout specifications, managing text-heavy pages, preparing print-ready files, and keeping a large book project organized.





Main Responsibilities



You will help our design team by:



-Creating textbook pages in Adobe InDesign based on detailed layout instructions

-Flowing manuscript text into book layouts

-Applying paragraph styles, character styles, object styles, and table styles consistently

-Building and reusing textbook components such as activity boxes, speech bubbles, motion cards, review sections, tables, callouts, and workbook exercises

-Formatting long instructional content so it is readable, clean, and age-appropriate

-Working with illustrations, icons, character art, and image placeholders

-Checking for overset text, spacing problems, inconsistent styles, and layout errors

-Preparing files for review and eventually for professional printing/publishing

-Making revisions based on feedback

Required Skills





Please apply only if you have strong experience with:



-Adobe InDesign

-Multi-page document layout

-Paragraph styles and character styles

-Parent/master pages

-Tables in InDesign

-Print layout and PDF export

-Careful formatting and revision work

-Following detailed design instructions





Helpful Additional Skills



These are not required, but would be a plus:



-Experience designing textbooks, workbooks, children’s books, educational materials, or training manuals

-Adobe Illustrator or Photoshop

-Experience preparing print-ready files

-Experience working with book grids, margins, bleed, and preflight checks

-Comfort working with Google Drive, Dropbox, or other shared file systems

-Strong English reading comprehension





Project Style



The books are instructional textbooks, not simple flyers or social media graphics. The work requires patience, consistency, and attention to small details.



Some pages will be colorful and kid-friendly, with cartoon characters, speech bubbles, activity boxes, and workbook-style exercises. Other books in the series will be more mature, like middle-school and high-school debate handbooks.



We will provide:



-Manuscripts

-Page-by-page design specifications

-Sample layouts and inspiration images

-Character art and illustrations when available

-Feedback and revision notes



You will help turn these materials into polished InDesign textbook layouts.





Ideal Candidate



You are a good fit if you:



-Are highly organized

-Can follow instructions carefully

-Notice small formatting inconsistencies

-Are comfortable revising work after feedback

-Can communicate clearly and reliably

-Have experience with long documents, not just single-page designs

-Care about making educational materials look professional and easy to use





Work Arrangement



-Remote position

-Need someone who can commit to 20-30 hours per week.

-Long-term project: approximately 9–12 months

-Flexible schedule, but regular communication and reliable deadlines are important





How to Apply



Please send:



-A short introduction about your InDesign experience

-Examples of multi-page documents you have designed or formatted

-Any textbook, workbook, magazine, booklet, or long-document samples

-Your expected hourly rate or monthly rate

-Your availability per week

-A short answer to this question:

What InDesign feature do you rely on most when formatting a long book or workbook, and why?



Applicants may be asked to complete a short paid test task using a sample textbook page.

title: Cold Caller / Outbound Sales Rep
description:
We are a U.S.-based lead generation platform for roofing companies. We help roofing contractors get access to exclusive roofing leads without monthly fees, contracts, or shared lead competition. Contractors can sign up for free, receive lead previews, and only pay when they choose to claim a lead.



We are looking for confident, fluent English-speaking outbound sales reps who can cold call roofing companies in the United States and get them signed up on our platform.



This is a sales role, not a basic VA role.



Your Main Job:

You will call roofing companies, speak with the owner or decision-maker, explain why our platform can help them get more roofing jobs, collect their
 and phone number, send them the signup invitation link, and follow up until they complete their free account setup.



Responsibilities:

- Cold call roofing companies in the United States

- Get past gatekeepers such as receptionists, office managers, and secretaries

- Ask for the owner, manager, or person in charge of buying leads/marketing if needed

- Clearly explain what our platform does and why contractors should sign up

- Convince interested prospects to create a free account

- Collect the correct
 and phone number from each prospect to send them the invite link

- Send signup invitation links to prospects

- Follow up with interested prospects who have not signed up yet

- Track calls, notes, follow-ups, and signup status accurately

- Report daily results, including calls made, conversations, interested leads, and signups

- Follow our script, sales process, and compliance rules



Requirements:

- Fluent English speaker

- Clear, confident phone voice

- American-style accent or neutral accent preferred

- Prior cold calling, appointment setting, BPO, SDR, or outbound sales experience preferred

- Comfortable calling U.S. business owners

- Able to handle rejection and objections professionally and pivot to still convince them

- Strong ability to speak naturally, not just read from a script

- Reliable internet connection

- Good headset or microphone

- Quiet work environment

- Available to work U.S. business hours

- Organized and able to follow up consistently



The Ideal Candidate:

- Has experience calling U.S. businesses

- Knows how to get past gatekeepers if needed

- Can talk confidently with business owners

- Understands how to sell value, not just read a script

- Can explain things simply and clearly

- Is persistent without being pushy or rude

- Wants a long-term sales role with commission upside



Example of What You Will Say:

“Hey, is the owner available? I’m calling from (our company). We help roofing companies get exclusive roofing leads with no monthly fee or subscription. Contractors can sign up for free, see lead previews, and only pay if they choose to claim a lead. I just wanted to send over the invite link so you can check it out, are you interested?.”



Important:

We are not looking for someone who only reads scripts. We need someone who can think, respond naturally, handle objections, and guide prospects toward signing up. You must be fluent at speaking english naturally in a conversation.



To Apply:

Please send the following:

1. A detailed message to us

2. Your cold calling or outbound sales experience

3. Your experience calling U.S. businesses, if any

4. Your internet speed test screenshot

5. Your headset/microphone setup

6. Your availability in U.S. Eastern Time

7. Your expected hourly rate

8. Why you think you would be good at getting roofing companies to sign up for our platform



You will be interviewed in a live call on your english fluency and sales ability. We are only considering serious applicants only. This is a long term position and we are looking for strong candidates, we look forward to reviewing your application.

title: Setup Specialist (Fresh Graduates or with Experienced, Permanent WFH)
description:
JOB OVERVIEW

Setup Specialist (Initial Disclosure Specialist)



Applicants must hold a Bachelor's degree in Finance, Economics, Business, Accounting, or a related field ONLY. Applicants without this degree requirement will not be considered.

We are looking for a highly detail-oriented Setup Specialist to join our mortgage operations team. Your main responsibility is to prepare and review initial mortgage disclosures to ensure accuracy, compliance, and timely delivery to borrowers. This is a great opportunity for someone who wants long-term stability, growth, and a work-from-home setup.



Job Responsibilities



Prepare and review initial mortgage disclosures with strict attention to accuracy and compliance.

Ensure disclosures are delivered on time and in accordance with federal and state regulations.

title: Team Lead for Collections
description:
If you’ve built a strong background in collections, have experience working within a UK collections company, preferably in fintech or BNPL and are ready to step into a leadership role managing your own team. Apply here: 
/appqyBZJyyxs1htVk/pagvvCsolTY5tzwa7/form



About the Role



We're looking for a Customer Collections specialist with strong, hands-on UK fintech collections experience who also has the leadership chops to grow into a team lead position as we scale.



Right now, this is an execution-first role. You'll be doing the work - managing collections, handling customer accounts, and running the day-to-day the same way any frontline agent would. But we're hiring with the future in mind. As the team grows, the right person will naturally step into a leadership position: owning processes, guiding new agents, and shaping how the collections function runs.



This means we need someone who is both an expert practitioner and a natural leader. You don't just know what good collections work looks like — you can do it, and eventually, you can teach it.



If you have direct, hands-on experience in UK-based collections or payments recovery within fintech, and you've either led a team before or have the instincts and drive to do so, we want to hear from you.



What You'll Do



You'll take ownership of the Collections function. Managing customer repayments, resolving account issues, and ensuring the team operates with professionalism and precision. You'll work with AI-driven tools as part of your daily workflow, but your domain knowledge and judgment are what make everything run.



Core Responsibilities

*Deliver exceptional multi-channel support (chat,
, and phone) with a focus on first-contact resolution and high customer satisfaction.

*Uphold brand standards by communicating clearly, consistently, and professionally in all interactions.

*Actively manage brand reputation by professionally responding to all customer reviews and public feedback.

*Handle and resolve customer complaints with empathy and efficiency, knowing when and how to appropriately escalate complex issues.

*Oversee customer repayments and collections: assist with payment management, rescheduling, and account oversight, with a clear understanding of UK collections compliance and best practices.

*Protect the business by proactively identifying, investigating, and escalating suspicious activity and potential fraud cases.

*Work extensively with AI-driven tools as a core part of your daily workflow. This is a very AI-forward role, so genuine comfort and curiosity with AI is a must.

*Build a real understanding of our processes, not just rely on AI outputs. Speed matters, but so does knowing the reasoning behind what you're doing.

*As the team grows, take on increasing ownership of the Collections function, leading agents, refining SOPs, improving recovery processes, and working closely with Customer Service Operations to keep both teams aligned and running smoothly.



IMPORTANT: Please read the responsibilities below carefully before applying, and follow the application instructions at the bottom.



What We're Looking For



*Proven, hands-on experience in UK collections — you've worked directly in a UK-facing collections or payments recovery environment, not just peripherally.

*Fintech sector background — you understand how BNPL, consumer credit, or flexible payment products operate in the UK market.

*Regulatory awareness — you're familiar with UK-specific requirements and the operational nuances that come with them (FCA guidelines, TCF principles, etc.).

*Strong communication skills — clear, professional, and empathetic in every interaction.

*Genuine comfort working with AI tools — you don't just use them, you understand how to guide them effectively.

*A fast learner who can make immediate and meaningful impact.

*Ability to lead and develop a team as the function scales.



Working Hours:

*Shift during onboarding 11am - 6pm UK time, Monday to Friday. After onboarding a fixed schedule will be provided depending on business needs.

*Must be willing to work during weekends

*This is a full time role only (40 hours per week)



Compensation:

*Competitive salary: $1,300 – $1,500 USD per month (depending on experience)

*Opportunity to grow into a Manager position (with a raise) as the support team expands.



Benefits:

*100% Remote - work from anywhere in the Philippines.

*15 days paid leave

*Semi monthly salary payouts

*Paid time off and Philippine public holidays

*Supportive, startup-style culture where your ideas matter

*Clear growth path and strong learning opportunities in fintech



How to Apply:

* Click the link below to submit your application and let's get started:

title: Short Form Video Editor
description:
You know MrBeast. Now work with the person who helped direct it.



Our founder spent years as a video director at MrBeast, working on content that generated over 10 billion views. He understands what stops the scroll, what keeps people watching, and what makes short-form content actually perform. That knowledge drives everything we do at Biggest Agency.



We produce high-end YouTube shows and podcasts for entrepreneurs and business leaders. We are growing our editing team and looking for a short-form editor overseas who is fast, precise, and obsessed with the craft.



What this role will do for you

Short-form editing is not just cutting a clip and slapping on captions. Done right, it is one of the most technical and creative skills in content production.



Our standards are high. Our feedback is direct. You will be pushed to understand why certain 
nts work and others do not, and you will get better faster here than almost anywhere else.



This role starts part-time with a clear path to full-time as the relationship grows.



What you will be editing

You do not pick the clips. Your Senior Editor or Account Manager identifies the 
nts from each episode. Your job is to make them hit.



Each clip is 60 seconds or under with clean captions, tight cuts, minimal motion graphics. The standard is high.



You will start with approximately 15 clips per week, growing to 30 or more as volume scales. At the production level required for this role, that is very achievable. We will grow your hours with you.



Finished clips are delivered through 
 for review before anything goes to the client. Revisions are part of the job and are not paid separately. Study the feedback. Apply it. Raise your standard before you submit.



One honest note: understanding what resonates with an American business audience takes time. The way a 
nt needs to be framed, paced, and hooked for this audience is specific. Your early cuts will often come back with feedback. That is expected and built into our process. The editors who grow fastest here are the ones who study American short-form content, pay attention to what performs, and treat every round of feedback as a lesson rather than a correction.



What we need from you

CapCut (primary tool for this role)

Adobe Premiere Pro (required)

Fast, reliable internet

Available during US business hours for communication and revisions



A note on your computer

Short-form editing at this production level is not as hardware-intensive as long-form, but your machine still needs to handle it cleanly. Before you apply, confirm your setup is solid.



Minimum specs:

Processor: Intel i5/i7, AMD Ryzen 5/7, or Apple M1 or newer

RAM: 16GB minimum

Storage: 512GB SSD minimum

Stable internet for file transfers and 



In your application video, show us your setup or walk us through your specs.



To apply

Record a 2 to 3 minute video. Introduce yourself, tell us how long you have been editing, show us short-form work you are proud of, and tell us why this role interests you. Upload it to YouTube or Google Drive and include the link.



The video matters more than your resume.

mbers regarding pending work

title: EOI - Setups Specialist
description:
We are seeking expressions of interest for Setups Specialist position.

Do you have a sharp eye for detail and a knack for getting complex setups right the first time?

MachShip is Australia's leading freight management platform, trusted by carriers, 3PLs, and shippers to move freight smarter every day. We're looking for a Setups Specialist to join our Cremorne-based team — someone who takes pride in precision, communicates clearly with customers, and plays a critical role in getting new accounts live and ready to go.

ABOUT THE ROLE

Reporting to the Setups Team Leader, the Setups Specialist is the engine behind every new customer going live on the MachShip platform. You'll configure accounts from end to end — from carrier assignments and rate cards through to quoting rules, manifesting settings, and custom workflows — making sure every setup is accurate, tested, and handed over without a hitch. You'll work closely with customers throughout the process and collaborate internally with Onboarding, Dev, Carrier Integrations, and Support teams to keep things moving smoothly.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

Customer Setup & Configuration

– Configure new customer environments in MachShip, including account structures, user access, carrier assignments, and operational preferences

– Set up rates, carriers, quoting rules, manifesting settings, and custom workflows tailored to each customer's requirements

– Validate data accuracy across carrier accounts, rate cards, surcharges, and integration fields

– Perform end-to-end testing to confirm complete setup integrity before customer launch

Customer Engagement

– Liaise with customers via the helpdesk to gather setup requirements, clarify data inputs, and guide them through the process

– Communicate clearly on setup progress, outstanding items, and timelines — keeping customers informed at every stage

– Educate customers on their system configuration outcomes and best-practice usage

Technical Administration & Data Handling

– Import, map, and validate rate cards, carrier settings, and configuration data

– Troubleshoot setup issues, identify configuration inconsistencies, and escalate technical problems when needed

– Maintain accurate, complete setup documentation throughout each engagement

Collaboration & Cross-Team Support

– Work alongside Onboarding, Dev, Carrier Integrations, and Support teams to ensure efficient handover and prompt issue resolution

– Provide practical feedback on setup processes, tools, and documentation to support continuous improvement

– Assist in refining setup templates, standard configurations, and process guides

Quality Assurance

– Conduct setup accuracy reviews prior to every handover

– Ensure all work complies with internal standards, carrier requirements, and operational best practices

– Identify and address recurring setup issues to reduce defects and rework

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

Skills & Attributes

– Strong attention to detail and high accuracy in data entry and configuration

– Clear communicator — able to explain technical concepts in plain language for non-technical customers

– Comfortable analysing and validating data: CSV files, spreadsheets, rate structures

– Solid problem-solving skills with a logical, methodical approach

– Ability to manage multiple setup tasks concurrently and prioritise effectively

– Collaborative team player who thrives in a structured, process-driven environment

– Previous experience in a customer-facing or client-service role

Bonus Points For

– Experience in customer onboarding, system setup, or technical administration

– Exposure to logistics, freight management systems, or supply chain operations (TMS/WMS)

title: Senior Client Accountant
description:
About JADDE Financial Solutions

JADDE Financial Solutions is a US-based virtual accounting firm serving small and medium-sized businesses across the NJ/NY/PA tri-state area, with a growing focus on contractors and trades industries. We deliver outsourced bookkeeping and Client Advisory Services (CAS) on a flat-fee model — meaning our clients always know what they're paying, and our team can focus entirely on doing excellent work.

We are a small, close-knit team that uses the latest tools — including AI-assisted workflows, QuickBooks Online, and video-first communication — to deliver consistent, high-quality results. We take our culture seriously: we are direct, professional, and genuinely invested in our clients' success.

The Opportunity

We are looking for a Senior Client Accountant who will serve as a trusted financial partner to a portfolio of US business owner clients. This is not a back-office role. You will own client relationships, deliver monthly financial reviews, and present findings directly to business owners via Zoom.

If you are an experienced accountant who is equally comfortable in a spreadsheet and on a video call with a client — and you take pride in explaining financials in a way that actually makes sense to non-accountants — this role was built for you.

What You’ll Do

• Manage month-end close and produce clean, accurate financials for a dedicated portfolio of US small business clients

• Conduct monthly and quarterly financial review calls with clients via Zoom — presenting P&L, balance sheet, and cash flow in plain language

• Perform account reconciliations, sales tax tracking, payroll entries, and other core bookkeeping functions in QuickBooks Online

• Identify financial anomalies, trends, and risks — and proactively communicate findings to clients

• Support cash flow forecasting and budgeting for clients who need it

• Collaborate with our internal team and contribute to continuous process improvement



What You’ll Bring

Required

• 5+ years of accounting experience, ideally in a client-service or firm environment managing multiple clients

• Strong working knowledge of US GAAP and US small business accounting practices

• Hands-on proficiency with QuickBooks Online (QBO)

• Demonstrated ability to present financial statements and analysis to clients on video calls — clearly and confidently

• Exceptional written and spoken English communication skills

• High attention to detail, strong analytical thinking, and a proactive approach to problem-solving



Nice to Have

• Philippine CPA designation or equivalent professional accounting credential

• Experience working with US-based clients in a BPO/KPO or remote firm setting

• Familiarity with US contractors, trades, or construction industry accounting

• Cash flow forecasting and budget preparation experience

• Experience with Gusto payroll, sales tax filings, or multi-entity accounting



A Note on Client Communication

This role requires regular, direct communication with US business owners via Zoom. We are not looking for perfect neutrality of accent — we are looking for clarity, confidence, and the ability to field questions on the fly. If you have experience presenting financials to clients and you take pride in how you communicate, that is what matters to us.

What We Offer

• 100% remote, work-from-home position

• Full-time engagement with a stable, growing US firm

• Collaborative team with genuine investment in your professional growth

• Direct access to firm leadership — no layers of bureaucracy

• A tech-forward environment: we use modern tools and are always looking for smarter ways to work

• Competitive compensation commensurate with experience



Our Hiring Process

• Step 1: Submit your application with the questions below answered.

• Step 1: Complete our online skills assessment via TestGorilla (link provided upon application — required to be considered).

• Step 2: Video interview with our team.

• Step 3: QBO Assessment

• Step 4; Team interview

• Step 4: Additional Assessments

Please answer each of the following in 2–3 sentences and send to

• How many years of hands-on experience do you have with QuickBooks Online?

• Describe a time you presented financial results to a client or business owner. What did you present, and how did you handle their questions?

title: Accounting & Procurement Specialist
description:
Summary

We are seeking a remote Accounting & Procurement Specialist to own both our bookkeeping and our quote desk.  The right person is someone who can do deep, careful financial work, but also pivot quickly when a client needs a quote or a purchase and have consistent communication and follow through.



This is a full-time remote role, Monday–Friday, 8:00am–5:00pm or 9:00am–6:00pm Pacific Time. You will coordinate closely with our sales and service teams.





KEY RESPONSIBILITIES



Banking & General Ledger

• Manage bank feeds — synchronize, categorize, and reconcile transactions daily.

• Maintain the general ledger in compliance with GAAP; prepare and post adjusting entries, accruals, and closing entries.

• Perform reconciliations for bank accounts and balance sheet accounts.



Accounts Payable

• Process bills, categorize expenses, and match purchase orders from ConnectWise PSA.

• Maintain vendor accounts including W-9s, contracts, and documentation.

• Prepare and submit payments for approval.



Accounts Receivable

• Review, process, and send invoices through ConnectWise Manage PSA.

• Record and reconcile payments from third-party platforms.

• Support collections, including direct client communication as needed.



Accounting Board & Quote Board Management

• Triage, assign, and manage tickets in ConnectWise PSA.

• Respond to quote requests same-day, create and track opportunities, sales orders, and purchase orders.

• Handle client billing inquiries, past due notices, and reconciliation reminders promptly and accurately.

• Ensure no ticket remains unacknowledged at end of day; all tickets require a status, owner, and internal note on next steps.



Quote Desk & Procurement

• Research product pricing, reach out to vendors for quotes, and apply appropriate markups to maximize margin.

• Conduct diligent follow-up on open quotes, pending orders, and vendor deliveries.

• Coordinate with the sales and projects teams on order status and delivery timelines.

• Create and manage client agreements; ensure accuracy across invoicing, credit memos, and billing reconciliations.



Compliance- Payroll and Taxes

• Enter and reconcile payroll data in QuickBooks; allocate payroll expenses to correct accounts.

• File state sales tax and California e-waste tax returns.

• Prepare and file annual IRS 1099-NEC and 1099-MISC forms.

• Support the CPA firm with tax preparation and audits.



Month-End Close & Reporting

• Manage month-end close including prepaids, COGS, depreciation, fixed assets, and adjustments.

• Generate and deliver end-of-month reports, reconciliations, and supporting documentation.

• Provide financial analysis including cash flow summaries as requested.



Systems & Integrations

• Maintain QuickBooks Online configurations, GL mappings, and product catalogs.

• Ensure ConnectWise and QuickBooks integrations are functioning correctly; support third-party payment integrations (Alternative Payments).



QUALIFICATIONS

• Minimum 2 years of full-charge bookkeeping experience with strong command of GAAP and US/California accounting requirements.

• Experience in an MSP, IT services, or technology-driven environment strongly preferred.

•       Procurement experience; understanding of IT products, purchasing channels, and vendor management.

• Proficiency with QuickBooks Online and ConnectWise Manage PSA strongly preferred; certification a plus.
